Example Social: posts older than 90 days will be deleted automatically in 30 days

Until then, your own settings apply. The settings of the automatic deletion show which of your posts will be deleted, and you can change them within the server's maximum. Deleted posts cannot be restored.

Open
https://social.example/settings/auto-delete

-- 
Example Social
https://social.example
Contact: admin@social.example

You get this email because email is on for “Notices of the automatic deletion of posts” in your notification settings. You can turn it off there.
Stop these emails: https://social.example/mail/unsubscribe?token=sample-unsubscribe-token
